hero.description: I'm Leonel Rosado, a full-stack developer from Mérida, México with 3+ years of professional experience building business systems, payment flows and web platforms. I work with PHP/Laravel and Node/Express on the backend and Vue 3 and React on the frontend, where I care most about clean, fast and accessible interfaces.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Building web experiences that
about.bio_1: I'm a full-stack software engineer based in Mérida, México, with a strong focus on the frontend. My degree in Virtual Environments and Digital Business (2025) gives me a broader view of how technology drives real business outcomes, not just how to write code.
about.bio_2: For 3+ years I've built ERPs, accounts-receivable systems, client portals, embedded e-commerce widgets and card payment flows, always in collaborative teams working with Scrum.
about.bio_3: I also take on freelance projects. I work autonomously, communicate proactively, and bring the same attention to detail from my professional work to every client engagement.

experience_1.description: Built the complete Expenses module of an ERP and contributed to the custom Accounts Receivable system and its customer portal.

experience_2.description: Worked on an Accounts Receivable system for a real estate company's contracts and payments, and built its customer portal with PayPal payments.

experience_3.description: Led the full redesign of “Ecom”, a widget embedded via iframe in external web apps, and redesigned “Tire Access”, an embedded e-commerce, improving responsiveness, UI and UX.

experience_4.description: Built Recurrent Payment, a complete credit and debit card payment gateway, plus Surcharge and Dual Pricing for the POS system. Ongoing support and improvements to the card payments module.

dulce.desc: Website and online menu for a (fictional) Mexican café and bakery: browse 33 products, search, save favorites and see whether it's open right now, all from your phone.
dulce.h1: Accent-insensitive search with filters stored in the URL (shareable and back-button friendly)
dulce.h2: Persistent favorites with Pinia + localStorage and a dedicated filter
dulce.h3: Accessible lightbox, keyboard navigation and prefers-reduced-motion support
dulce.h4: Unit tests (Vitest) and end-to-end tests (Playwright) running in GitHub Actions CI
dulce.alt_lightbox: Product photo lightbox on a phone

nexus.desc: Marketing landing page for a fictional SaaS product, built to be fast and accessible by default: static HTML, a few tiny scripts and nothing else.
nexus.h1: Lighthouse 100 in all four categories, with budgets enforced in CI
nexus.h2: WCAG 2.1 AA audited automatically with axe-core
nexus.h3: Progressive enhancement: everything is visible and usable without JavaScript
nexus.h4: Native dialog demo form with validation and loading, success and error states, plus an accessible billing toggle
nexus.alt_pricing: Pricing table with annual billing selected

project_1.title: Recurring Payments & POS Pricing
project_1.desc: A complete payment gateway for recurring credit and debit card charges, plus Surcharge and Dual Pricing options in the point-of-sale system to expand in-terminal payment choices.
project_1.role: Implemented the Recurrent Payment gateway and the Surcharge / Dual Pricing features; ongoing support of the card payments module.

project_2.title: Embedded E-commerce Redesign (Ecom & Tire Access)
project_2.desc: Full redesign of two products embedded via iframe in external web applications: the “Ecom” widget and the “Tire Access” e-commerce, focused on responsiveness, UI and UX.
project_2.role: Led the Ecom redesign and redesigned Tire Access end to end on the frontend.

project_3.title: Accounts Receivable & Customer Portal
project_3.desc: Accounts Receivable system to manage a real estate company's contracts and payments, extended with a customer portal where clients check their account and pay online through PayPal.
project_3.role: Contributed to the AR system and built the customer portal, including the PayPal payment integration.

project_4.title: ERP Expenses Module
project_4.desc: Complete Expenses module for a custom ERP, adding new operational features to record and control company spending inside the existing system.
project_4.role: Built the module end to end during my internship, from the views to the business logic.

service_1.title: Frontend development
service_1.desc: Custom UI implementation with React or Vue.js 3. Clean, component-based code that's readable, maintainable, and easy for your team to extend.

service_2.title: Responsive UI & redesigns
service_2.desc: Make your existing app look and feel great on any screen. I audit layouts, modernize design, and improve usability without breaking what already works.

service_3.title: Web apps & client portals
service_3.desc: Business tools, dashboards, and portals built from scratch. I have direct professional experience with these systems and can deliver them reliably.

service_4.title: PHP / Laravel & Node.js backends
service_4.desc: Full-stack when you need it. I build and connect Laravel or Express APIs, MySQL databases, authentication and payment integrations (cards, PayPal) to power your frontend.
